_bytes_per_token: How many bytes of dense markdown cost one token. 2.93 was calibrated on one project by a natural experiment: a commit moved 156,574 B out of CLAUDE.md and the next session's opening context fell 53,520 tokens. Run --calibrate to derive your own; do not inherit this number if you can measure it.
_fixed_harness_tokens: The part of opening context you do NOT control — system prompt, tool schemas, skill listings. Budget your documents as a fraction of this. --calibrate prints it as the regression intercept.
_growth_run: Consecutive non-shrinking measurements before this warns, INDEPENDENT of absolute size. This is the trigger that matters: the 38-session run that motivated this tool never tripped a ceiling, because every individual step was small. It is also the only check that survives someone raising a ceiling to silence a warning.

resident._: Everything your harness injects in full before the session starts. 34,000 B / 2.93 = 11,604 tok = about a third of the 35,700-tok fixed floor. If your CLAUDE.md is bigger than this today, do not raise the ceiling to make it green — that records the problem as the standard.
